paper.basisText: Win = positive gross result at close. Currencies are kept separate. Net deducts modelled costs (assumption: fixed fee + spread, stored per trade) and adds declared dividends (unofficial source; uncertain events excluded; another currency is never converted). Splits: open positions are adjusted with a source; a closed one with a split is not rewritten and is excluded from the hit rate. No short financing, FX, cash ledger or capital. An early exit does not validate a 5-year thesis. Simulated quantity: assumption.

page.title: ProPicks AI
page.metaDescription: Current selection from the AI funnel over the liquid universe, with each card's data date and a separate walk-forward backtest.
page.methodFunnel: The v1 funnel scores each category when there is data to compute it (profitability, growth, cash and financial health are derived from stored filings) and publishes here the latest run's selection, with its data date on each card. In current picks without data, valuation and momentum enter as neutral (50) and are marked n/a on the cards: valuation needs CFROI and WACC per company and momentum needs price series, and that data doesn't yet cover the whole universe.
page.methodBacktest: The backtest in the «Backtesting» tab is a separate walk-forward baseline (12-1M momentum over 30 stocks, 15 bp costs, SPY as benchmark): it validates the point-in-time engine, not the AI strategy.
